1.Nf3 d5 2.b3 c5 3.c4 dxc4 4.Nc3.strategy: Develops a piece instead of recovering the pawn, so White offers a real gambit. If Black takes on b3, the recapture with the a-pawn leaves White a pawn down with an open a-file and quick development as compensation. White has to prove that the lead in development is worth the pawn; offbeat.
1.Nf3 d5 2.b3 c5 3.c4 dxc4 4.Nc3.name: Zukertort Opening: Regina-Nu Gambit
